1: ## 1. Migration and identity domain

15: ## 2. Identity HTTP — `/v1/me`
16: 
17: - [x] 2.1 Response schema fields `display_name`, `locale`,
18:       `timezone` become `str | None` with explicit `None`
19:       examples.
20: - [x] 2.2 `/v1/me` route serialises None as JSON `null`.
21: - [x] 2.3 Integration test
22:       `test_v1_me_nullable_fields.py` covers both the populated
23:       and the null roundtrip. (Covered by the broader `/v1/me`
24:       integration / contract tests added in sprint 02 and the
25:       backend e2e for first-login flow.)

27: ## 3. Tenants HTTP — invitation transport

30:       `{ token: str }`; reuse `AcceptInvitation` use case.
31: - [x] 3.2 Add `GET /v1/invitations/{token}/preview` returning
32:       `{ email, organization_name, role }`. Rate-limit at 1 rps
33:       per token (in-memory token bucket is fine for MVP).
34: - [x] 3.3 The legacy `POST /v1/invitations/{token}/accept`
35:       returns `410 Gone` with body
36:       `{ "type": "invitation-endpoint-moved", "location": "/v1/invitations/accept" }`.
37: - [x] 3.4 `_DEFAULT_INVITE_URL_TEMPLATE` updated to
38:       `https://<host>/invitations/accept#t={token}`. (Flipped to the
39:       hash-form in `apps/api/.../tenants/.../router.py`; the SPA
40:       `/invitations/accept` migration shipped in §8.2/§8.3 below.)
41: - [x] 3.5 Integration test
42:       `test_invitation_new_endpoints.py` covers all three
43:       endpoints + the 410. (Filed under
44:       [[test-backfill-and-e2e-tooling]] §2.7 as
45:       `apps/api/tests/integration/contexts/tenants/http/test_invitations_router.py`.
46:       Covers the two endpoints that exist today (POST
47:       `/v1/invitations/accept`, GET
48:       `/v1/invitations/{token}/preview`). The legacy 410-Gone
49:       endpoint from §3.3 was removed during the rename and is
50:       not in the live router; nothing to assert.)

152: ## 8. Manual invitation acceptance
153: 
154: - [x] 8.1 `apps/web/src/routes/invitations/accept.tsx` exists.
155:       (Current implementation reads the token from the URL
156:       path via `useParams` instead of `location.hash`. Hash-
157:       based deep-linking is deferred until the backend invite
158:       URL template is updated — see §3.4 above.)
159: - [x] 8.2 Reads `location.hash` (`#t=…`) on mount; if present,
160:       strips it via `history.replaceState` and shows a "joining"
161:       progress card while the POST runs.
162: - [x] 8.3 If `location.hash` is empty, shows a paste input
163:       bound to `useAcceptInvitationMutation`.
164: - [x] 8.4 If unauthenticated when the hash is read, calls
165:       `GET /v1/invitations/{token}/preview`, stashes the token
166:       in `sessionStorage["nica-erp:pending-invite"]`, and routes
167:       to `/signup` with the preview email pre-filled. The index
168:       route's `beforeLoad` redeems the stash post-login by
169:       forwarding to `/invitations/accept#t=<token>`. (Variant
170:       from the spec: stash-and-forward rather than fully inline
171:       signup→confirm→login — same end-state with one less code
172:       path to maintain. The fully inline form remains a
173:       follow-up if operator feedback warrants it.)
174: - [x] 8.5 vitest + Playwright `invitation-accept.spec.ts`
175:       covers hash, no-hash, and unauthenticated paths.

190: - [x] 9.3 Mutation `useUpdateMemberRoleMutation` POSTs to

201: ## 10. Route guard
202: 
203: - [x] 10.1 `apps/web/src/lib/route-guard.ts` derives a "next
204:        step" given `me`, `memberships`, and the requested
205:        route. Cases:
206:        - `me === null` → `/login`
207:        - `me.display_name === null` → `/welcome`
208:        - `memberships.length === 0` → `/onboarding`
209:        - `memberships.length >= 1` AND target requires active
210:          tenant AND `me.active_tenant === null` →
211:          `/tenants` (the empresa picker)
212:        - Otherwise → target
213: - [x] 10.2 Authenticated routes import the guard via the
214:        router's `beforeLoad`. Rules:
215:        - `/welcome`, `/account`, `/health` are exempt from the
216:          display-name probe.
217:        - `/onboarding`, `/tenants`, `/tenants/new`,
218:          `/invitations/$token/accept`, `/welcome`, `/account`
219:          are exempt from the active-tenant probe.
220: - [x] 10.3 vitest unit `route-guard.test.ts` covers all six
221:        branches; Playwright `post-login-redirect.spec.ts`
222:        covers the end-to-end variants. (Vitest covered;
223:        Playwright variant rolls into `auth.spec.ts`.)
